editcheck-dialog-addref-description: Taimaka wa masu karatu su fahimci inda wannan bayanin ya fito ta hanyar ƙara ambato.
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-question: Me ya sa ba ka ƙara ambato ba?
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-descripti: Sauran editocin za su fi son ƙarin bayani game da shawararka ta rashin ƙara ambato.
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-irrelevan: Ba na tsammanin ambaton ya dace da canjin da nake yi
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-common-kn: Bayanin da nake ƙarawa sananne ne sosai
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-uncertain: Bani da tabbacin wani ambato zan kara
editcheck-copyvio-description: Don Allah a guji kwafan rubutu daga wasu majiyoyi, koda kuwa an sake fasalta shi ko an ambace shi. Wannan za a iya ɗaukarsa a matsayin [{{int:editcheck-copyvio-descriptionlink}} keta haƙƙin mallaka ko satar bayanai] kuma yana iya haifar da cire abubuwan da ke cikin ko kuma toshe asusunku.
editcheck-copyvio-prompt: Kai ne ka rubuta wannan rubutun?
editcheck-copyvio-keep-description: Don Allah a taimaka wa sauran editocin wannan labarin su fahimci dalilin da yasa kuke adana rubutun da aka manna.
editcheck-copyvio-keep-wrote: Na rubuta wannan rubutu kuma ba a wallafa shi a wani wuri ba
editcheck-copyvio-keep-permission: Wannan rubutu yana da lasisin kyauta
editcheck-copyvio-keep-other: Duka abubuwan da aka lissafo basu da alakan
editcheck-copyvio-keep-notify: Nagode da bayyana dalilanka na adana rubutun da aka liƙa!
editcheck-copyvio-llm-title: Abubuwan da za a iya samar da su ta AI
editcheck-copyvio-llm-description: Rubutun da ka lika da alama an ƙirƙira shi ne ta hanyar AI, wanda yawanci ana ba da izinin hakan ba.Taimaka wajen tabbatar da cewa labaran sun kasance masu aminci ta hanyar tabbatar da cewa sun bi  manufar wannan [{{int:editcheck-copyvio-llm-policylink}} wiki game da amfani da AI].
editcheck-copyvio-llm-keep-edited: Na rubuta wannan rubutun da kaina, kuma na yi amfani da AI don yin ƙananan gyare-gyare a ciki.
editcheck-copyvio-llm-keep-not-ai: Na rubuta wannan rubutun da kaina. Ba wallafin AI ba ne.
editcheck-copyvio-llm-keep-generated: Na yi amfani da AI don ƙirƙirar wannan rubutun kuma na tabbatar da cewa ya bi ka'idojin AI na wannan wiki.[{{int:editcheck-copyvio-llm-policylink}}]
editcheck-copyvio-llm-keep-other: Babu wani daga abubuwan dake sama.
editcheck-copyvio-llm-keep-notify: Nagode da bayyana dalilanka na adana rubutun da aka liƙa!
editcheck-double-bold-title: Cire Tsarin Tsarin da ba dole ba Mai manyan bugu
editcheck-double-bold-description: Ana amfani da manyan bugu ta atomatik ga ƙananan kanun labarai, sharuɗɗan jerin ma'ana da kanun teburi. Taimaka wa masu karatu ta hanyar cire [{{int:editcheck-double-bold-descriptionlink}}]tsarin manya bugu mara amfani daga waɗannan abubuwan
editcheck-preference-suggestions-descrip: Shawarwarin gyara da aka tsara ta  a cikin al'umma don inganta labarai. Aƙwai a cikin [[:mw:Special:MyLanguage/Help:VisualEditor/User_guide|visual editor]].
editcheck-preference-experimental-enable: Kunna gwaje-gwajen duba gyara da shawarwari
editcheck-preference-experimental-help: Wannan zai nuna gyaran da aka duba da kuma shawarwarin da ake cigaba dayi a yanxu.
editcheck-tone-description: Wasu masu amfani kan yi wa irin wannan rubutun gyara, suna cewa sautin bai daidaita ba. [{{int:editcheck-tone-descriptionlink}} Ƙara koyo]
editcheck-tone-footer: An gano ta amfani da [{{int:editcheck-tone-footerlink}} BERT model]
editcheck-tone-description-acted: Ka kula da maganganun da ke nuna yabo, ɓatanci, rashin tabbas, rashin fahimta, ko kuma amincewa da wani ra'ayi na musamman.
editcheck-tone-reject-uncertain: Ban tabbata ba yadda za a sake fasalin sautin ba
editcheck-tone-thank: Na gode da yin la'akari da sautin!
editcheck-sourceveri-description: Wani samfurin ya gano cewa wannan ikirarin ba zai samu goyon bayan tushensa ba. Yi la'akari da sake duba tushen da abun ciki, da kuma sabunta ko dai idan ya dace.
editcheck-sourceveri-footer: Wannan shawara ce da aka samar ta hanyar na'ura wadda [{{int:editcheck-sourceveri-footerlink}} AI Source Verifier] ya gano.
editcheck-sourceveri-reject-irrelevant: Shawarar ba ta da wani amfani. Majiya ta goyi bayan wannan ikirarin.
editcheck-sourceveri-reject-valid-nofix: Wannan shawarar tayi amman ba zan gayara ba yanzu.
editcheck-yearlink-description: Wannan hanyar haɗin yanar gizo tana nuna wata shekara daban da wadda aka nuna a cikin rubutun. Taimaka wajen sa labarin ya zama daidai ta hanyar sabunta shekarar da aka nuna da shekarar da aka haɗa don dacewa.
editcheck-suggestedlink-description: Wannan rubutun bai haɗu da wani labari ba. Ƙara hanyar haɗi zuwa [{{int:editcheck-suggestedlink-descriptionlink}} taimaka wa masu karatu su kara koyo] game da wannan batu.
editcheck-suggestedlink-footer: Hanyoyin da aka ba da shawarar an samar da su ne ta hanyar inji. Bincike kafin ƙarawa.
editcheck-external-link-description: Wannan hanyar haɗin [{{int:editcheck-external-link-descriptionlink}}] yanar gizo tana nuna wani gidan yanar gizo na waje. Taimaka wa masu karatu su mai da hankali kan rubutun ta hanyar cire wannan hanyar haɗin yanar gizon, mayar da ita zuwa sashin "Haɗin Haɗin Waje", ko kuma mayar da ita zuwa ambaton [{{int:editcheck-external-link-convertlink}}] idan ya dace.
editcheck-duplicate-link-title: Cire haɗin da aka yi maimaici
editcheck-duplicate-link-description: Wannan hanyar haɗin yanar gizo ta bayyana fiye da sau ɗaya a cikin wannan sashe. Taimaka wa masu karatu su kewaya cikin sauƙi ta hanyar cire hanyoyin haɗin yanar gizo da aka maimaita [{{int:editcheck-duplicate-link-descriptionlink}}].
editcheck-adjacent-link-title: Haɗa hanyoyin haɗin da ke kusa
editcheck-adjacent-link-description: Wadannan hanyoyin haɗi iri ɗaya suna kusa ko a rabe ne kawai ta hanyar sarari. Taimaka wa masu karatu kewaya da sauƙi ta hanyar haɗa su cikin hanyar haɗi ɗaya.
editcheck-disambiguation-description: Wannan hanyar haɗin yanar gizon tana nuni zuwa shafin [{{int:editcheck-disambiguation-descriptionlink}}]. Taimaka wa masu karatu su sami maudu'in da ya dace ta hanyar haɗawa zuwa wani takamaiman shafi.
editcheck-headinglevel-description: Wannan matakin kanun labarai ba zai bi tsarin da ya dace ba. Taimaka wa masu karatu su kewaya abubuwan cikin sauƙi ta hanyar amfani da matakin kanun labarai daidai [{{int:editcheck-headinglevel-descriptionlink}}].
editcheck-leadlength-description: Wannan sashe ya fi tsayi fiye da yadda [{{int:editcheck-leadlength-descriptionlink}} {{SITENAME}} tafarkin]  da aka bada shawara. Yi shawara rage shi ta hanyar yin abubuwa kamar tura bayanai zuwa wasu sassa ko maye gurbin dogayen jimloli da waɗanda suka fi sauƙi.
editcheck-leadlength-reject-appropriate: Tsawon ya dace da wannan labarin
editcheck-leadlength-reject-uncertain: Ban san yadda zan yi gajeriyar hanya ba
editcheck-leadlength-thank: Na gode da la'akari da tsawon sashen jagora!
editcheck-image-caption-description: Wannan hoton ba shi da taken rubutu. Taimaka wa masu karatu su fahimci dalilin da yasa hoton yake da mahimmanci ta hanyar ƙara ɗan gajeren taken rubutu [{{int:editcheck-image-caption-descriptionlink}}].
editcheck-convertreference-description: Wannan bayanin bai da cikakkun bayanai. Taimaka wa masu karatu su fahimci inda bayanin ke fitowa ta hanyar canza shi zuwa tsarin [{{int:editcheck-convertreference-descriptionlink}}]. Bayan an canza shi, a duba daidaiton bayanan da kayan aikin ya ƙara, sannan a cire duk wani abu da ba daidai ba ko kuma ya ruɗani.
editcheck-reject-description: Sauran masu gyara za su yi matuƙar amfani da sanin dalilin da ya sa ka yi wannan zaɓin.
editcheck-specialeditchecks-info: An tsara duban gyara a [[MediaWiki:Editcheck-config.json]]. Don takardu, duba [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Edit_check/Configuration Edit check/Configuration].
